name: Flat White
caffeineNote: Raposa's product page states 150 mg of caffeine
summary: Raposa's nitro cold brew with oat milk, from the brand's own site and not yet checked against a can: 150 mg of caffeine and 80 calories in a 250 mL (8.45 oz) can. Raposa's page disagrees with itself on sweetness: its title calls the can unsweetened, while its ingredient list, cold brew at 62.45%, oat beverage at 35.4%, sugar and inulin, includes sugar. It publishes no sugar or protein figures.
